about: A labelled enum's branch of another shape (chapter 2 § 2.9): each is exactly { "const", "title" }. Invalid: the package format review's verdict writes its second branch without a title. Valid: with one.
sentences: Format 'review' at /properties/verdict writes oneOf branch 2 as {"const":"…"}; each branch is exactly { "const": <value>, "title": <label> }.
